units.source_text: 此亲王是桐壶帝的第八皇子，源氏的异母弟，称为“宇治八亲王”。

en.t: This prince was the eighth son of Emperor Kiritsubo, Genji's half-brother by another mother, and was known as the "Eighth Prince of Uji."

units.source_text: 此后十回，称为“宇治十帖”，主要人物只是薰君、匂皇子及此亲王的三个女儿。

en.t: The next ten chapters are called the "Ten Uji Chapters"; their main figures are only Lord Kaoru, Prince Niou, and this prince's three daughters.

units.source_text: 本回写薰君二十岁至二十二岁秋末之事。

en.t: This chapter describes events from Lord Kaoru's twentieth year through the end of autumn in his twenty-second year.
